executive_judgment.core_claim: The useful change is not better style; it is generation governed by shared entity state, evidence map, uncertainty model, and dimension roles before findings are written.

trial_matrix.main_learning: Entity ambiguity becomes the governing condition instead of hidden fragmentation.
Similar names are not converted into aliases or one strategy.
Related surfaces stay review-gated instead of becoming one platform story.
The useful behavior is restraint and evidence discipline, not adding entity complexity.
Fallback language can be compressed, but thin evidence should stay thin.

improvements.summary: State-first prevents distinct uncertainty types from collapsing into one confident story.
Findings become clearer about what evidence supports and what it cannot support.
Repeated caveats are moved to shared uncertainty rules instead of repeated per finding.
LaunchDarkly shows state-first can stay light when the entity is stable.
Netlify mock shows state-first can reduce fallback sameness without inventing depth.

unsolved: Manual trials do not prove automation.
State-first does not fix missing finding-level evidence URLs.
State-first does not replace entity discovery.
Outputs can read more diagnostic than final report prose.
Fluent state-first prose can hide uncertainty if caveats are compressed too aggressively.

recommended_next_phase.title: Specify Lab-Only State-First Findings Generator v0
recommended_next_phase.purpose: Define a strictly offline input/output contract and workflow for generating candidate artifacts comparable to the manual trials.

generator_preconditions: Narrative Harness diagnostics exist or can be built offline
EntityNarrativeState exists or can be built offline
the case has enough evidence to build a meaningful evidence map
related surfaces are explicit or reviewed, not inferred from arbitrary URLs
explicit_non_goals: apply state-first to Brand Audit production output
add more architecture before testing generation behavior
let Lab claim these findings are official
hide uncertainty to make the result look better
infer related surfaces from name similarity
treat state fields as prose to quote directly
